location: Proof 1.1 and Facts F2–F4: adapted totally-geodesic metric and exponential tube
subject: thm-whitney-move-removes-a-cancelling-pair-of-intersections

evidence.note: Current producer Proof 1.1 and its contract still require an unproved simultaneous adapted metric and framed tube. Product charts give pointwise sheet coordinates; ordinary partitions do not supply the asserted normal-constant compatible partition, and the ordinary closed-submanifold tube theorem supplies neither cornered-disk tube nor sheet-exact geodesics. Attempted closure by the germ transition fails because it compares tubes already constructed. Milnor Lemma 6.7, printed p.73, states the needed adapted model; Lemma 6.8, pp.74–77, obtains totally geodesic sheets by separate tubular antipodal symmetrizations agreeing in Euclidean corner overlaps, followed by geodesic/frame constructions. Ranicki 7.27, pp.139–140, also presupposes the model. This is a substantial producer-owned prerequisite. Required owner decision: batch 14 must fully prove and declare the adapted-tube construction with its metric/geodesic prerequisites, or provide a sound relative coordinate tube, then route the corrected supplier for review. Batch 19 cannot edit it; both finding and consumer risk remain open.

The observed producer gap was fatal: ordinary partitions and tubular germ comparisons supplied no simultaneous sheet-adapted framed tube. It is now repaired by the owner-authored lem-a-clean-framed-whitney-bigon-has-an-adapted-tube, six complete local steps: joint smooth cornered-disk/frame extension, prescribed tangent flags, compact normal exponential sheet tubes, antipodal averaging with Euclidean-only overlap agreement and unchanged zero-section metric, fixed-geodesic uniqueness, uniform globally injective disk tube and exact sheet inverse images. The canonical theorem now applies that supplier in step 1.1 and supplies the compact swept-set bump in step 2.1. Its Statement and first-sheet-only action are unchanged. This author reread the current helper/theorem and the exact propagated consumer uses, with no new unresolved adapted-tube prerequisite. The original fatal observation and its source binding remain historical; this current repair does not recast it as a false positive or immediate omitted coordinate.
